The '''Duinarbulon Archives''' was a [[Library/Legends|archive]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duinarbulon]]. According to records held in the archive, prior to [[the Devouring]]&mdash;a campaign of [[Speciecide|extermination]] by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] in [[24,500 BBY]] against the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] colonies of the [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Kiirium Reaches]]&mdash;the Hutts had raided the planets of the Kiirium Reaches for [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] but left the worlds largely unharmed.<ref name="Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster" />
